[Unit]

# AppArmor profile confining the inventory application (port 8181)
#include <tunables/global>

/opt/inventory-app/app.py {
  #include <abstractions/base>
  #include <abstractions/python>
  #include <abstractions/nameservice>

  network inet stream,
  network inet6 stream,

  /usr/bin/python3.12 ix,

  /opt/inventory-app/app.py r,
  /opt/inventory-app/ r,
  /opt/inventory-app/inventory.db rwk,
  /opt/inventory-app/inventory.db-journal rwk,

  /usr/lib/python3.12/{,**} r,
  /usr/lib/python3.12/lib-dynload/*.so mr,
  /usr/lib/python3/dist-packages/{,**} r,

  /etc/python3.12/**  r,
  /etc/localtime r,

  deny /home/** rwklx,
  deny /root/** rwklx,
}
EOF
apparmor_parser -r /etc/apparmor.d/opt.inventory-app.app.py && echo PARSE_OK

sed -i 's|ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /opt/inventory-app/app.py|ExecStart=/opt/inventory-app/app.py|' /etc/systemd/system/inventory-app.service
cat /etc/systemd/system/inventory-app.service
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now inventory-app.service
sleep 1
systemctl is-active inventory-app.service
systemctl status inventory-app.service --no-pager -l
